newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Yields fall on 91-day Lithuanian T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on 91-day Lithuanian T-bills.

text.p: The average yield on Lithuanian 91-day Treasury bills slipped on Monday to 9.03 percent from the 9.83 percent they fetched at the last auction for 91-day paper on June 24, the central bank said.
Amounts are in millions of litas unless otherwise stated.
MATURITY AV YIELD (LAST) MIN/MAX YIELD ISSUE BID SOLD
The settlement date for the auction is July 10 and the bills mature on October 9.
The next auction will be held on Tuesday, when 50 million litas of 182-day paper will be offered,
